Seraphel is still at the chapel, so the question waits.

You read by the fire while the card game turns increasingly argumentative. Thessaly has not improved the rules, whatever she claims; Dena wins another hand one-handed and accepts the victory with a satisfied, “There. Civilization endures.”

Rashid groans and gathers the cards for the next deal. The primer stays open across your knees, its account of committees and provisional human duties steady in the firelight.
